mentions.name: Lowkey Viewer
mentions.description: This is a self-hosted media platform offering similarity search, face search, and clustering across a personal media library. It includes a media player with shuffle, a VS mode that ranks media into an Elo score, remote web access to the app, and a TikTok-style swipe mode for browsing one's own media. It has been developed over five years and has a small Patreon following.
mentions.source_excerpt: Self hosted media platform with similarity search, face search and clustering, a great fun media player with shuffle, VS mode where you rank your media resulting in an elo, remote access to app over the web, a TikTok style "swipe" mode of your own media. Started as just a good media viewer over 5 years ago but I just keep adding things.
mentions.author: tracerbulletx
